title: CP Trainer course
description: courses/<subject>.json: the suggested order of a subject's lessons (a line on the map), split into sections. Every unit belongs to exactly one course. The order is a suggestion; nothing is locked.

subject.description: A visible subject id from taxonomy.json; the file is named after it.

sections.description: In order: básico, then intermedio, then avanzado (the map's zones).

id.description: Permanent within the course, e.g. basico.

nameEs.description: Spanish name. Falls back to name.

units.description: Unit ids in suggested order. Unit <subject>.<name> lives in units/<subject>/<name>.json.
